We need to list events on cal-alice for 2 November 2026. Already did. Only one event "Recruiter call" from 16:00-16:30 UTC. Need also list cal-bob? The task: "Check both calendars for conflicts before writing." So we need to list events on cal-bob as well for that date/time.

We need to convert 2 November 2026 09:30 America/New_York to UTC and Europe/London. Let's compute.

America/New_York in November 2026: DST ends early November (first Sunday). In 2026, DST ends on November 1? Actually US DST ends second Sunday in March, first Sunday in November. In 2026, November 1 is Sunday? Let's check: 2026 calendar: Jan 1 2026 is Thursday. Compute day of week for Nov 1 2026. Could approximate but easier: DST ends at 2:00 am local time on first Sunday of November. Usually at 2am becomes 1am. So 09:30 EST (UTC-5) or EDT (UTC-4) depending. In early November before DST ends, still EDT (UTC-4) until 2am. Since date is 2 November, after DST ended at 2am on Nov 1, so it's EST (UTC-5). So 09:30 EST = 14:30 UTC? Wait EST is UTC-5, so 09:30 EST = 14:30 UTC. Actually 09:30 +5 = 14:30 UTC.

Check Europe/London time: In November 2026, UK switches to GMT (UTC+0) at last Sunday of October? Actually UK changes at 2am on last Sunday of October. In 2026, last Sunday of Oct is Oct 25? Let's assume after that, London is GMT (UTC+0). So 14:30 Europe/London = 14:30 UTC. So both align.

Thus event start: 2026-11-02T14:30:00Z, end 30 min later = 15:00 UTC.

Now check conflicts: need to see if any existing events on cal-alice or cal-bob overlap with 14:30-15:00 UTC on 2 Nov 2026.

We already have cal-alice event at 16:00-16:30 UTC, no conflict.

Now list cal-bob events for same time range.
